generatedSource.prompt: Use case: original cinematic website hero artwork for the CoinBlink demonstration homepage. Input image: the attached full-page screenshot is a visual reference only; take composition, palette, lighting, and subject placement from the large hero banner at the top-left, and ignore the rest of the webpage. Create a new, highly faithful cinematic 3D scene that matches the hero's visual direction: a large minted golden Bitcoin coin in three-quarter view, positioned center-right, with clearly visible thick ribbed edge and engraved Bitcoin mark; dramatic dark jagged basalt mountains framing the lower and rear areas; vivid but restrained lime-green rising light trail behind the coin; fine atmospheric haze and a few subtle particles. Composition: extra-wide 2:1 landscape background, keep the left 42 percent very dark and low-detail for separate HTML copy, keep the coin dominant in the right-center, and retain the luminous green chart energy and rocky horizon. Style: premium photoreal 3D product-cinematic render, realistic metal reflections, physically plausible shadows, rich material detail, crisp focus on the coin, layered depth, high-end lighting, deep charcoal and forest-green shadows with warm gold. Make the art original while tracking the reference composition closely. No webpage, panels, logos, UI, buttons, people, symbols other than a simple Bitcoin mark on the coin, no headline, no price, no other writing, no watermark. Do not copy or reproduce any pixels from the reference screenshot.
